snippet.title: Flipside Steam Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Flipside demo is now live on Steam – what do you think?

And 

With our devlog series, the demo of our game Flipside will be available to players at Steam Next Fest on October 13th!

Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4048630/Flipside_Demo
